xref.title: Children with Linda McCartney
xref.body: Paul McCartney had three children with Linda McCartney: Stella, a fashion designer; Mary, a vegetarian activist and photographer; and James, the only musician among them, who has appeared on albums by both Paul and Linda and has his own records. He also adopted Linda's daughter, Heather, who is a potter. "He had three children with Linda. Stella is a famous fashion designer. There's Mary, who's a vegetarian activist and photographer. There's Heather, who is a famous potter, as she makes pottery. And Paul adopted her when he married Linda. The only musician in that bunch is James, another one of Linda's kids."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Collaborations and Friendship
xref.body: James McCartney has appeared on albums by both his father, Paul McCartney, and his mother, Linda McCartney. He became friends with other Beatles offspring—Danny Harrison, Zach Starkey, and Sean Lennon—and they entertained the idea of forming a band, though it didn't come to fruition. "He's appeared on albums by both Paul and Linda and has several records of his own. He eventually became friends with Danny Harrison, son of George, Zach Starky, son of Ringo, and Sean Lennon, son of John. They floored with the idea of forming their own band. Imagine that, but nothing ever came of it."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
